# Shane Brannan

Shane Brannan is the person Dan talked to about **video games**, and
almost only about video games. Nineteen tweets between June 2011 and March
2016 — eighteen of them opening with his handle, which makes this a
direct-address relationship rather than a name Dan drops in passing — and
the subject matter barely varies.

He had no page here until 2026-09-02, and he is not named anywhere else in
the corpus: no message thread, no Facebook exchange, no appearance on
another person's page. He exists in the tweet archive and in one row of
`contacts.csv` (`Shane, Brannan`, `7248586899`, `twitter.com/shane_brannan`,
`jayysus@live.com`) — a 724 number, which is Fayette/Westmoreland County,
placing him in the Uniontown orbit rather than the Orlando one.

## What they talked about

| Date | The tweet |

| 2011-06-27 | *"no tbh I dedicate the little bit of gaming time I do have strictly to star2. You play?"* |
| 2012-07-19 | *"DUDE have you played Slender yet? I'm scared to fucking death of this game"* |
| 2012-07-20 | *"imo 100x scarier than Amnesia. For reals. Also, this weeks workaholics 👍"* |
| 2012-07-20 | *"fuck EVERYTHING about/in that game. I'm going back to playing dayZ"* |
| 2012-07-20 | *"the worst part is that the character model is so bad…but it's still scary as fuck when you turn and it's there"* |

StarCraft II, World of Warcraft's auction-house economy, Slender, Amnesia,
DayZ, Halo 4, Call of Duty: Black Ops II — and a console that was "6 years
old" in November 2012, dating an Xbox 360 purchase to roughly 2006, which
is the same teenage window [[wiki/interests/video-games]] documents from
Facebook ("slaying on halo").

## The friendship is legible entirely through one subject

Two things are worth noticing about a relationship this narrow.

**It is a real channel, not small talk.** The Halo 4 sequence runs across
four days and five tweets — the purchase, the hardware failure, the
diagnosis, the replacement console, the request for a gamertag. Dan bought
a new Xbox rather than wait, and narrated it in real time to one person.
The Slender exchange is craft criticism: *"the character model is so bad…
but it's still scary as fuck when you turn and it's there"* is an
observation about how horror design survives bad assets, not a reaction.

**It is also the only such channel.** Nothing here is about Uniontown,
family, work, music, or politics — the subjects that organise every other
relationship on this wiki. Whatever else Shane was to Dan, the public
record of it is a co-op partner. The two tweets outside the pattern are the
6 November 2012 group address (*"@JoshBrannan @Shane_Brannan @jebskis I'm
in haytrobe miss you fux"* — written from New York, missing home) and the
last one, 17 March 2016, which is a joke video about walking.

## Gaps

Who he is to [[wiki/people/josh-brannan|Josh]] is undocumented — the shared
surname and the joint address of 6 November 2012 establish that they are
connected, and nothing establishes how. Whether the friendship continued
past March 2016 is unknown: he does not appear in any message export the
corpus holds, which may mean the friendship ended, moved to a platform
nothing here archives, or simply never used SMS. The 724 number in
`contacts.csv` is undated, so it cannot settle it.
